snippet.title: Paint Gang - Chaotic co-op painting
snippet.description:
Mix colors by eye, race across a giant canvas, and try not to step in the wet paint. Paint Gang is a chaotic online co-op game for 1–4 painters where every masterpiece becomes a team-made disaster.

wishlist on steam  https://store.steampowered.com/app/5152700/Paint_Gang/
